templates.why_chosen: Pairs one fully expanded MoE Block on the left with a tiled timeline of the same block repeated on the right, contrasting a one-shot Prefill pass against per-token Decoding steps at dense text density.
templates.what_to_learn: Expand the repeated unit once on one side (the MoE Block's internals) and tile the collapsed version across a timeline on the other side, so structure and repetition-over-time each get their own half instead of competing in one drawing.

templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from block-floorplan by the note-writer: this is a neural-network block diagram (one MoE Block's internals) paired with a stacked timeline of repeated block invocations across prefill and decoding; nothing is hardware, and there is no chip or bus.
templates.what_to_learn: Read this as a phase-lanes or replicated-grid figure instead: expand one MoE Block fully on the left, then tile the same block repeatedly along a timeline on the right, one wide invocation for the whole prefill prompt and one narrow invocation per decoded token.
